title: Delegation from Technical University of Darmstadt, Germany Visits RIKEN AIP (September 29, 2026)
sourceName: RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project
content: On September 29, 2026, a delegation from Technische Universität Darmstadt (TU Darmstadt), Germany, including Prof. Dr. Thomas Walther (Vice President for Innovation and International Affairs), Professor Dr. Hans-Werner Hammer (Professor, Institut für Kernphysik – Theoriezentrum), and Mr. Lars Bergmeyer (Senior Advisor, Asia/Pacific), visited the RIKEN AIP in Nihonbashi, Tokyo. The delegation was received by Team Director Naoto Yokoya, Team Director Takayuki Osa, and Akira Takahashi, Director, and Yasushi Ogasaka, Coordinator, from the Office of the Center Director. Nihonbashi 1-chome Mitsui Building, 15th floor, e-mail: aip-koho [at]riken.jp *Please replace "[at]" with "@".
